name: logos-blockchain-node.public.dappnode.eth
description: **Community-maintained, UNOFFICIAL** Logos blockchain node — not an official Logos release. Headless Logos 0.3.0 testnet node: generates a fresh config + keys on first run (IBD peers filled), persists chain state to a volume, and runs PoW mining capped to 1 thread with auto-claim. Mining threads, mining on/off, and log level are configurable in the setup wizard. A bundled Prometheus exporter feeds the DAppNode monitoring stack (DMS) a ready-made Grafana dashboard. Testnet is ephemeral (re-genesises each release). For the official package, watch for a signed release in the curated DAppStore.
author: xAlisher
